events.description: CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief reports Bin Ladin's money movers adjusting to UN sanctions on the Taliban.
CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief reports Bin Ladin's money movers adapted to UN sanctions on the Taliban; overland funds through Pakistan are more vulnerable to confiscation or theft.
UN sanctions halted currency shipments directly from Dubai to Afghanistan aboard Taliban-controlled Ariana flights; the flow continues through less direct channels.
Funds moving overland through Pakistan became more susceptible to government confiscation or theft as a result of the sanctions.
